newsitem.title: USA: Duckwall-ALCO adds 17 stores in fiscal Q1.
newsitem.headline: Duckwall-ALCO adds 17 stores in fiscal Q1.

text.p: Duckwall-ALCO Stores Inc said Tuesday it opened 17 stores in its fiscal first quarter ended May 4.
"At quarter end, 75 percent of our stores were located in non-competitive markets," Glen Shank, president, said in a statement.
Duckwall-ALCO, which operates 203 stores in the central United States, said its strategy is to target smaller markets not served by other regional or national discount chains.

Earlier, Duckwall-ALCO reported earnings for the first quarter of $849,000 or $0.17 a share on 5.1 million shares outstanding, compared with year-ago earnings of $703,000 or $0.18 a share on 4.0 million shares.
Sales for the quarter rose to $69.3 million from $59.3 million.
"Increases were seen across a broad spectrum of departments, including housewares, toys, consumables and outdoor living," Shank said.
